def: properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear

words.word: thee thou wilt have a desire

occurrences.text: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
words: thee thou wilt have a desire

occurrences.text: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
